llms.intro: NODUS ECOSYSTEM (digital strategy) is a digital marketing and growth strategy agency based in Colombia that works with companies across Latin America and North America. It combines paid media (Meta Ads, Google Ads and TikTok Ads), social media content strategy, web development and landing pages with Next.js, AI automation (WhatsApp chatbots, n8n, Make), CRM implementation under its ARM concept (Automatic Relationship Management) and SEO and AI search optimization (GEO). It works in no-lock-in monthly plans with clear deliverables and full client ownership of accounts, data and digital assets. It replies within 24 hours with an action plan.
keyFacts: Monthly plans with no lock-in: the client decides when to adjust or scale.
100% client ownership: ad accounts, code (Next.js), CRM databases and automations from day one.
Results model: business metrics (CPA, ROAS, qualified leads) instead of vanity metrics.
Coverage: Latin America and North America, with communication in Spanish and English.

ARM (Automatic Relationship Management): the NODUS concept for a self-updating CRM; a unified WhatsApp, Instagram and Telegram inbox, an automated pipeline, calendar and the NODIA AI assistant, built on the Nodus CRM platform.
Operating base: Colombia (remote-first); business hours Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 18:00 (Colombia time).

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.subheading: Everything you need to know about the monthly plan, the investment, the guarantee and the ownership of your digital assets.

items.question: How does the monthly plan work?
items.answer: Each month we run a continuous cycle of diagnosis, planning, execution, optimization and reporting with our monthly cycle methodology. The team works toward clear objectives and you decide when to adjust or scale the scope based on your business priorities.

items.question: Is there a minimum commitment or long-term contract?
items.answer: No. We work month to month with no lock-in clauses. If you decide to cancel, you only need to notify us before the next cycle starts. We hand over full ownership of the documentation, digital assets and developed code to guarantee your company's continuity.

items.question: Does the plan cost include the advertising budget and tools?
items.answer: No. The monthly plan covers our team's strategy, execution, development and optimization. Ad budgets (Meta, Google) and software licenses (CRM, servers) are paid directly to the platforms in your company's name.

items.question: Do the accounts, developments and databases stay in my name?
items.answer: 100% yes. All ad accounts, web code access (Next.js), CRM databases and automations are the exclusive property of your company from day one.

items.question: How do we manage communication if we're in different countries or time zones?
items.answer: We work with agile methodologies, keep fluid communication through WhatsApp for day-to-day matters, real-time dashboards to track progress, and strategy sessions by video call scheduled in your local time zone.

items.question: How soon will I see results?
items.answer: You'll see the audit and action plan in the first week. The first measurable results arrive between the first and second month: optimized ads, active funnels and conversion improvements on your website.

items.question: What does the first week include?
items.answer: A full audit of your digital presence, competitive analysis, KPI definition and an actionable monthly plan. By the end of the week you'll know exactly what we're going to do and why.

items.question: What guarantee do you offer on deliverables?
items.answer: Compliance and scope guarantee: at the start of each cycle we approve a work plan with KPIs and precise dates. If an agreed deliverable is not met, it is compensated in the next cycle or not billed. We also review the results together in a monthly call before renewing.

items.question: Who executes the plan?
items.answer: A dedicated team: strategist, paid media specialist, developer and automation expert. We work with shared tools so you can see progress in real time, with no intermediaries.

items.question: Do you work with our in-house team?
items.answer: Yes, it's our favorite way to work. We integrate with your team, document processes and train you so you depend less on us over time and can grow with our tools.

definition.heading: What does a paid media agency do?
paragraphs: A paid media agency manages your company's ad spend on platforms like Meta, Google and TikTok: it defines audiences, structures campaigns, produces copy and creatives, sets up tracking and optimizes the budget to get results at the lowest possible cost. The specialist who runs this work day to day is often called a media buyer or, in Latin America, a digital trafficker.

At NODUS ECOSYSTEM paid media never runs in isolation: it connects with your content, your website or conversion landing page and the automation that answers every lead on WhatsApp. That way an ad doesn't end in a click, it ends in a conversation your team can close.

faq.question: What is a media buyer or digital trafficker?
faq.answer: It is the specialist who sets up, launches and optimizes a brand's paid campaigns on platforms like Meta Ads, Google Ads or TikTok Ads. They choose audiences, budgets and creatives and analyze the data to lower the cost per result. At NODUS every client gets a dedicated paid media specialist.

faq.question: Is the ad budget included in the plan?
faq.answer: No. The monthly plan covers strategy, ad creation and optimization. Ad spend is paid directly to Meta, Google or TikTok from your company's ad account, which always stays in your name.

faq.question: Which platforms do you run ads on?
faq.answer: Mainly Meta Ads (Facebook, Instagram and click-to-WhatsApp campaigns), Google Ads (Search, Performance Max and YouTube) and TikTok Ads. We choose the mix based on where your customers are and which funnel stage needs results.

faq.question: How long until paid media shows results?
faq.answer: Campaigns generate data from the first week. Cost per lead usually stabilizes between the first and second month of testing, once we know which angles, audiences and formats work for your business.

faq.answer: Yes. For example, for SV Tejas y Acrílicos Internacional, a retail company in Colombia, messaging campaigns generated 2,314 conversations in five weeks. You can see more cases on our home page.

definition.heading: Why is your website part of your sales strategy?
paragraphs: A business website isn't a digital brochure: it's where your ads land, where Google and AI assistants learn who you are and where a visitor decides whether to contact you. If it loads slowly, doesn't explain the offer or doesn't track conversions, your whole marketing budget performs worse.

At NODUS we design every automation with a clear handoff between bot and people: the assistant answers common questions and qualifies the prospect, and your team takes over the conversation when there's buying intent.

crm-arm.metaDescription: ARM (Automatic Relationship Management): a CRM with a WhatsApp inbox, an automated sales pipeline and an AI assistant for companies across the Americas.
crm-arm.intro: We implement ARM, our way of taking the CRM one step further: a system where your company's conversations, leads, calendar and follow-up organize themselves, and an AI assistant helps you decide what to do next.

definition.heading: What is ARM (Automatic Relationship Management)?
paragraphs: ARM, or Automatic Relationship Management, is the concept NODUS ECOSYSTEM uses for a CRM that doesn't depend on someone updating it by hand. In a traditional CRM your team logs every contact and moves every deal; in an ARM, WhatsApp, Instagram and Telegram messages land in a single inbox, a bot qualifies the prospect and moves it through the pipeline, and reminders and reports are generated automatically.

The difference between a CRM and an ARM is who does the operational work: in a CRM it's your team; in an ARM it's automation and AI, and your team steps in where it adds the most value: the sales conversation.

faq.question: What's the difference between a CRM and an ARM?
faq.answer: A CRM stores your customer information and depends on your team to keep it updated. An ARM (Automatic Relationship Management) automates that work: it receives messages, qualifies prospects, moves them through the pipeline, books meetings and sends reminders on its own, with AI that helps you prioritize.

posicionamiento-seo.intro: We make your company show up when customers search for what you sell, both on Google and in AI assistants like ChatGPT, Perplexity or Gemini. We combine technical SEO, useful content and authority signals.

definition.heading: What is generative engine optimization (GEO)?
paragraphs: SEO (search engine optimization) is the work of improving your site so it appears at the top of Google results. GEO (generative engine optimization) extends that work to AI answer engines: the goal is for ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini or Google's AI Overviews to cite your company when someone asks about your service.

Both share the same foundation: a fast, crawlable site, content that answers real questions clearly, structured data that explains who you are and mentions on trusted sources. That's why we work on them together.

faq.question: How long does SEO take to show results?
faq.answer: Technical fixes can show impact within a few weeks, but organic rankings usually consolidate in three to six months, depending on keyword competition and your site's starting point.

faq.question: How do I get ChatGPT to recommend my company?
faq.answer: AI assistants cite sources they understand and trust. It helps to have content that answers specific questions, structured data describing your company, an llms.txt file, consistent directory profiles and mentions on third-party sites. No one can guarantee a recommendation, but these signals raise the odds of being cited.

faq.question: Does SEO replace paid media?
faq.answer: No, they complement each other. Paid media brings immediate results while SEO builds a traffic channel that doesn't depend on daily spend. Many of our clients combine both.

faq.question: Do you do SEO for multiple countries or languages?

paragraphs: It's the plan that defines what your brand publishes, for whom, in which format and with what goal. Instead of posting for the sake of it, every piece plays a role in the funnel: attracting new audiences (TOFU), building trust (MOFU) or driving the purchase (BOFU).

At NODUS we measure content strategy with business metrics, not vanity metrics: conversations, leads and sales coming from your social channels. It also connects with paid media to amplify what performs best.

faq.answer: Mainly Instagram, TikTok and Facebook, plus LinkedIn for B2B companies. We choose the networks based on where your ideal customer spends time.

faq.question: What is the TOFU, MOFU and BOFU funnel?
faq.answer: They are the stages of the buying journey: TOFU (top of funnel) attracts people who don't know you yet, MOFU (middle of funnel) builds trust with education and social proof, and BOFU (bottom of funnel) invites them to buy or reach out. A good content strategy balances all three.

faq.question: How do you measure whether content works?
faq.answer: Beyond reach and engagement, we measure the conversations, leads and sales that come from your social channels, so we know which content drives business and not just likes.

faq.question: What is social SEO?
faq.answer: It's optimizing your profiles and posts with keywords, captions and text that help Instagram, TikTok and search engines show your content to people searching for topics related to your business.
